results.name: string_to_lowercase
results.evidence: Iterates a null-terminated byte string (unaff_EDI) calling _tolower on each character in place until the terminating NUL, a plain in-place ASCII lowercasing loop.
results.summary: Lowercases a null-terminated string in place using the CRT tolower().

results.name: time_query_performance_counter_ms
results.evidence: Calls QueryPerformanceCounter, multiplies the 64-bit counter by 1000 with __allmul, then divides by the cached frequency (DAT_006ac8f8/DAT_006ac8fc) with __alldiv; the decompiler drops the EAX:EDX return of the final __alldiv, but the arithmetic is the standard QPC-to-milliseconds conversion.
results.summary: Reads the high-resolution performance counter and converts it to milliseconds using a previously cached counter frequency.

results.name: directory_create_recursive
results.evidence: Calls GetFileAttributesA to check if the path already exists; if not, walks the path splitting on '\' (skipping the first two components for UNC "\\server\share" paths via _strpbrk) and calls CreateDirectoryA on each successive prefix, wrapped in SetErrorMode(0x8000) to suppress the critical-error dialog for missing drives.
results.summary: Creates a directory and all of its missing parent directories, correctly skipping the server/share components of UNC paths, returning whether the full path exists or was successfully created.

results.name: memory_global_alloc
results.evidence: Direct passthrough to GlobalAlloc(0, size) with the size taken from an implicit register argument (in_EAX) and no fixed-flag/moveable handling beyond flags=0.
results.summary: Thin wrapper allocating a block via the Win32 GlobalAlloc API.

results.name: memory_global_free
results.evidence: Direct passthrough to GlobalFree(handle) with the handle taken from an implicit register argument (in_EAX).
results.summary: Thin wrapper freeing a block via the Win32 GlobalFree API.

results.name: profile_path_initialize
results.evidence: Checks the "-path" command-line flag (command_line_check_flag) to optionally override the profile directory; otherwise calls an SHGetFolderPath-style function pointer (DAT_0074626c) and formats "%s\\My Games\\Halo" into DAT_006ac900 via __snprintf, printing "Using profile path %s.\n"; falls back to "." and shell_display_fatal_error_dialog on failure.
results.summary: Determines and stores the player's profile directory path, honoring a -path command-line override or defaulting to "<Documents>\My Games\Halo", with a fatal-error fallback if the special-folder lookup fails.

results.name: write_to_error_file
results.evidence: Naming hint 'write_to_error_file' matches the code exactly: on first use it self-recursively writes a header block ("halo pc 01.00.10.0621(CACHE) ----...") including its own address (write_to_error_file) and the literal string "_write_to_error_file"; otherwise it opens debug.txt via FUN_004e40a0/FUN_00624186, optionally prefixes a localtime timestamp, and fprintf's param_1 as the message.
results.summary: Appends a (optionally timestamped) message string to the game's debug.txt log file, writing a one-time header block on first use.
